eyebrow: Two rules, two very different scopes
code:
$ aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-0a1b2c3d

IpPermissions:
  - IpProtocol: tcp
    FromPort: 443
    ToPort: 443
    IpRanges: [0.0.0.0/0]
  - IpProtocol: tcp
    FromPort: 5432
    ToPort: 5432
    UserIdGroupPairs: [sg-0f9e8d7c]  # app servers only
caption: Port 443 is open to everyone; port 5432 is open only to the app tier's own security group.
